crossRefs.note: Jesus answered them, “Isn’t it written in your law, ‘I said, you are gods?’
But this happened so that the word may be fulfilled which was written in their law, ‘They hated me without a cause.’
So that the law has become our tutor to bring us to Christ, that we might be justified by faith.
Tell me, you that desire to be under the law, don’t you listen to the law?
At the mouth of two witnesses, or three witnesses, he who is to die shall be put to death. At the mouth of one witness…
One witness shall not rise up against a man for any iniquity, or for any sin that he sins. At the mouth of two…
Set two men, wicked fellows, before him, and let them testify against him, saying, ‘You cursed God and the king!’ Then…
But if he doesn’t listen, take one or two more with you, that at the mouth of two or three witnesses every word may be…
This is the third time I am coming to you. “At the mouth of two or three witnesses shall every word be established.”
A man who disregards Moses’ law dies without compassion on the word of two or three witnesses.
If we receive the witness of men, the witness of God is greater; for this is God’s testimony which he has testified…
I will give power to my two witnesses, and they will prophesy one thousand two hundred sixty days, clothed in…

translations.web: It’s also written in your law that the testimony of two people is valid.
translations.bsb: Even in your own Law it is written that the testimony of two men is valid.
translations.kjv: It is also written in your law, that the testimony of two men is true.
translations.asv: Yea and in your law it is written, that the witness of two men is true.
